meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页交互与数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器执行重复操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions and extract web data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control a browser programmatically for repetitive tasks

howto.what: 装上后，你可以让Claude控制浏览器，自动导航到网站、点击按钮、填写表单、截图、提取网页数据或测试网页应用，并且页面状态在多次操作中保持不变。
howto.when: 当你要求浏览网站、填写表单、截图、抓取网页数据、测试网页或提到“go to [url]”、“click on”等浏览器交互关键词时触发。

say.text: 打开百度首页，截图保存。
帮我登录推特，填写用户名和密码。
say.note: Claude会控制浏览器自动登录。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can control a browser to navigate websites, click buttons, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, or test web apps, with page state persisting across script executions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to browse websites, fill forms, take screenshots, scrape data, test websites, or mention phrases like "go to [url]" or "click on".

say_en.text: Open Baidu homepage and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude will launch the browser and capture.

say_en.text: Log into Twitter for me, filling in username and password.
say_en.note: Claude will automate the login process.
